payload.what_did_not: The sealed forecast remains31.6 points below the opening midpoint. Recent holdout coverage was poor. We did not validate the full adjusted model, model other CPI components forward, use exact2026 seasonal factors, or forecast the remaining gasoline-price path. These are concrete shortcomings, not evidence that Kalshi is wrong.
